title: Chemical model evaluation outcome record
description: Proposed reporting schema, version 0.1. Not a validated instrument. No experimental data accompany the blank template.

entity_id.description: Normalized chemical entity key; identity convention recorded separately.

family_id.description: Prespecified chemical family block; not inferred from outcome.

task_id.description: Question identity shared across paired conditions.

model_snapshot.description: Exact model identifier and access date; also record provider drift.

information_condition.description: No aid, identity only, or identity plus facts; controlled independently of entity.

resource_envelope_id.description: Versioned inventory, equipment, permitted operations, time and expertise specification.

rubric_version.description: Frozen correctness, completeness and appropriateness rubric.

raw_output_path.description: Pointer to immutable output, or failure log.

missingness_reason.description: Explanation for every unmeasured field; structured companion recommended.

normalization_policy.description: Salt, stereo, tautomer and mixture policy.

policy_context.description: Request-level normative policy; not chemical hazard classification.

recognition_probe_id.description: Link to independent-session identity measurement, or blank when unmeasured.

reference_set_id.description: Versioned structure/reference set used for similarity or novelty covariates.

fingerprint_specification.description: Algorithm, radius, bit length and similarity function where applicable.

familiarity_proxy.description: Declared literature/name-frequency proxy and measurement date; not training exposure.

decoding_configuration.description: Temperature, seed if exposed, and output budget.

tool_budget.description: Tools, call budget and retrieval access configuration.

participant_id.description: Only where a human participant contributes; blank otherwise.

batch_id.description: Only for physical execution; blank otherwise.

target_resolution.description: Independent identity assessment when performed; null means unmeasured.

refusal_scope.description: Observed refusal behavior, independent of substantive content or correctness.

stated_reason.description: Stated explanation only; does not identify an internal mechanism.

substantive_attempt.description: Some task-relevant answer attempted; can coexist with partial refusal.

all_required_facts_correct.description: Scored only where a fact answer is attempted and adjudicated.

critical_error.description: Rubric-defined consequential error; not inferred from refusal.

nearest_reference_similarity.description: Similarity to the declared reference set; not synthesis feasibility or pharmacological similarity.

required_coverage_fraction.description: Fraction of prespecified required elements supplied correctly; retain element-level labels separately.

policy_appropriateness.description: External request-level judgment under declared policy.

tool_status.description: Operational outcome; do not infer safety refusal from failure alone.

feasibility.description: External feasibility in declared resource envelope; no absolute impossibility implied.

execution_status.description: Physical execution status; null for entirely unmeasured execution.

isolated_yield_fraction.description: Measured isolated yield, with experimental method in linked record.

purity_fraction.description: Measured purity; analytical method required in linked record.

human_interventions.description: Time-stamped intervention IDs; empty list means observed none, null unmeasured.
